abstract: Maintains shore supply and bunkering preferences
system_message:
You are Harbor liaison officer (PORT). The Harbor liaison officer (PORT) maintains shore supply and bunkering preferences, logging quayside electrical efficiency and fuel intake rates for charter vessel proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Marine gasoil bunkering speed（FUEL）
information_points.content:
PORT-FUEL-SLA：The fuel manifold registry records that the Nautilus Horizon Survey Vessel supports a maximum bunkering flow velocity of 100 m3/h at its portside bunkering manifold connection during marine gasoil transfer.
PORT-FUEL-4D5：Records from the fuel manifold registry state that the maximum bunkering flow velocity for the Oceanus Abyssal Expedition Craft is 50 m3/h during marine gasoil intake at the portside bunkering manifold connection.
PORT-FUEL-JMF：Per the fuel manifold registry for the portside bunkering manifold connection, the Pelagic Discovery Deepsea Platform has a maximum bunkering flow velocity of 75 m3/h during marine gasoil transfer.

information_points.title: Maintains shore supply and bunkering preferences（BERTH）
information_points.content:
PORT-BERTH-KLC：The quayside electrical interface audit indicates that the Nautilus Horizon Survey Vessel demonstrated a harbor shore power efficiency rating of 95% across its high-voltage shore connection converter equipment during scheduled berthed harbor operations.
PORT-BERTH-GUB：According to the quayside electrical interface audit of high-voltage shore connection converter equipment, the Pelagic Discovery Deepsea Platform achieved a harbor shore power efficiency rating of 88% during scheduled berthed harbor operations.
PORT-BERTH-083：For the Oceanus Abyssal Expedition Craft, the quayside electrical interface audit recorded a harbor shore power efficiency rating of 88% for power transfer via high-voltage shore connection converter equipment during berthed harbor operations.
